g.text: RGB observability and remaining readout errors
Known Dev: 512 episodes × 2 horizontal object coordinates; fixed readers, no refitting
RGB centroid uses renderer color identity. Privileged diagnostic only — not a learned-model benchmark.
Pixel units = normalized coordinates × 224. Bottom cases were fixed before this RGB audit; the auxiliary bbox rule is not plotted.
